title: 016 小boss哈根017 计划与拖延

016 小BOSS 哈根！
在关雨的认知中，所谓的侦探，形象大概和小岛国制作的一部长寿动漫《死神小学生》中的‘沉睡的小六郎’差不多。
封无这样的侦探也太凶猛了一些，枪法变态，头脑变态，资产变态，简直就是变态。
关雨压根不相信他是个普通的侦探。
封无将车开到夜总会五百米外就停下，三人都没有下车，静静的等待着。
托妮已经结束她那毫无意义的祈祷，此时从她小腿长靴处拔出两把弯刀，这弯刀弧度很小，非常的锋利尖锐，她细心的用布擦拭着。
这两把弯刀就是她母螳螂称号的来源！
三人都不是那种没有耐心的人，封无麻利的组装好狙击枪，同时将两把银色的手枪取出开始装上消声器。
关雨虽然有了法杖，但也没有轻视其他的工具，手枪子弹满上，接着擦拭了一遍所有的刀具。
接着三个人就养精蓄锐，随时准备应付各种突发状况。
大概十一点半的时候，终于陆陆续续有车开来，这些车就是没有标识的警车，显然警方也不想打草惊蛇，要给哈根来一个突袭。
警车的数量一共有五辆，其中两辆还是面包车，这时候只见车上下来一个人，慢慢走向封无的车，最后敲了一下封无的车窗。
“老流氓，准备的怎么样，哈根可是极有可能携带重武器，你们这点人可不够看。”封无拉开车窗，淡淡的说道。
来人正是老流氓，显然他也参与了这次逮捕行动，而陈同反而没有到场，毕竟他不是干这个的料，应付一下老百姓还可以，对付这种犯罪分子，恐怕一眨眼就躺下。
“等一下武警那边也会有人到场，出不了差错，这次就算哈根那老小子长了翅膀都飞不掉。”老流氓叼着根烟，点火之后眯着眼吸了一口，随即自信的说道。
封无依然平淡，道：“等一下要是撑不住就赶紧走，我带来好家伙，等一下或许能帮上忙。”
“我看看，我靠，巴雷特m107狙击步枪，这玩意你从哪搞到的，不会是那个什么温小姐帮你弄的吧，说实话，你是不是和那妞有一腿？”老流氓顿时低声惊呼道，随即猥琐的看着封无。
在老流氓的眼里，封无和温媛确实极为登对，两人简直就是天作之合，可惜封无一直都否认。
“我和温小姐只是合作关系，谈感情大概不可能。”封无果然就否认了，面上依然表现的极为淡然。
老流氓也没有继续打趣封无，而是看向车内，看到托妮的时候眼睛一亮，接着看到关雨的时候先是一愣，然后看向封无低声道：“那家伙是谁？”

“他的代号是零，是温小姐派来援助我们的人，实力不是我们可以比拟，你最好不要探究那么多。”封无同样低声道，似乎这是什么秘密。
老流氓听了，顿时嘀咕道：“那些掌权的家伙就是心里弯弯道道太多，算了，老子也管不了，我先回去了。”
这就是权力的好处，封无只是拉了一点关系，就算是老流氓这样的警察混混都不敢乱来。如果封无不是和温媛有关系，而温媛又让警局局长退避三分，恐怕老流氓会立即要求关雨把脸上的骷髅面具脱下来，然后接受检查。
同样看到封无车里那么多的武器，恐怕立即要抓捕他们。
终于十二点到来，武警也准备就绪，立即一小撮的人涌进夜总会，大概三分钟过后，夜总会就传出枪声还有女人的尖叫声。
封无淡淡的开口道：“交战开始了，先开枪的是哈根那边的人。”
“你怎么知道？”关雨意外道。
托妮笑道：“封无的五官很敏感，可以从枪声听出枪的型号。”
“警察用的枪都是统一的制式枪支，而刚刚的枪声并不是警用枪发出的枪声。”封无解释道。
忽然夜总会传出爆炸声，随即数十个武警也赶紧冲入夜总会，显然出意外了。
“发生什么事了？”关雨心里顿时有一种不祥的预感，哈根怕是得到了不得了的技能，不然这样的警力加上突袭，不可能失败。
过了一会儿，开始有武警从夜总会跑出来，三人都看到老流氓忽然从夜总会飞出，整个人撞在面包车上面，面包车的表面顿时凹陷下去，老流氓就这样歪歪的倒在地上。
“出事了，恐怕哈根不是那么好对付。”封无凝重道。
这时候一个武警还拿着枪对着夜总会射击，面上却是一脸的恐惧，仿佛看到了怪物。
忽然一个黑影从夜总会里面飞出，撞在那武警身上，武警顿时连同黑影倒飞出去。
等停下来才看清楚，那黑影竟然也是一个武警，将一个武警扔出来，这需要多大的力气？
终于一个全身散发着金光的大汉走出来，这大汉大概四十来岁，头发向后抹，上身穿着白色无袖背心，下身则穿着一条花花游泳裤，整个人显得精壮无比。
“他就是哈根，不过他身上的光？”封无细声道。
关雨摇头道：“不清楚，不过应该是技能的效果。”
这时候埋伏在四周的武警开始射击，子弹落在哈根身上竟然只是产生一点火花，他面上毫无恐惧，反而冷笑的看着四周的警察。

“真是怪物。”托妮看到这一幕，不禁低声感叹道。
哈根这时候动了，他随手捏碎夜总会前面的大理石柱子，一只手抱着柱子猛的前冲，对着四周就是横扫过去，一个武警拖着老流氓逃过攻击，但四周的车子却遭了殃，已经变成破铜烂铁。
忽然楼上传来一声枪响，狙击枪！
不过子弹落在哈根身上只是造成一个细小的红点，他抬头看向对面楼顶，忽然大吼一声，直接将石柱投掷向那大楼。
“他的力量是多少？”关雨心里震惊的看着哈根，这样的石柱，恐怕他的力量再加一倍才有可能抱得动，而向哈根这样投掷出去，至少还要两倍以上才有可能做到。
哈根的力量和防御都远远超出他的想象。
事实上不单只他一个人震惊，封无和托妮都震惊的说不出话来，哈根的表现已经颠覆了他们的想象力，这样的画面应该出现在影院的荧屏上，而不是出现在现实之中。
石柱并没有攻击到那狙击手，但却撞在了楼房的三楼，不过只是撞烂了一面墙。
哈根的实力还不能够随意的拆掉建筑物，这已经是他力量的极限。
“好了，接下来我们上吧，哈根这技能不可能没有时间限制，已经过了将近三十分钟，我们耗也能够耗死他，托妮等一下千万别被他抓住，哈根的力量足以将你撕成两半。”封无这时候说道。
托妮点点头，立即
而关雨也走下车，手里握着唐刀慢慢的向哈根走去，面对这样强大的敌人，他的压力非常大，不过他就是那种一旦决定就绝不回头的类型，而且他们胜算还是很高，所以他还是决定要拼一把！
哈根只不过是力量和防御比他要高，但速度的话，哈根在他眼里就太慢了，天下武学，唯快不破，只要够快，力气再大也没用，因为打不中！
封无则抱着狙击枪向老流氓那边走去，实际上武警还有不少没用受伤，只不过是被哈根的表现所震慑，现在不敢冒头而已，老流氓据说以前就是武警，应该有点关系，这点可以利用一下。
托妮这时候已经和哈根交手，她两手握着手枪快速的对哈根进行射击，不过和其他人一样，子弹打在哈根身上就不断的发出火花，却没一枚子弹能够穿透哈根的身体。
哈根看到托妮，顿时狞笑道：“没想到母螳螂也来找死，待会别让我抓到，不然我非把你撕开两半，连逼都是两半！”
“哼，你这混蛋，待会死了我就把你J8割下来泡酒。”托妮也恶狠狠的骂道。
虽然托妮恨不得立即干掉哈根，不过她可不傻，所以根本不靠近哈根，而哈根的速度并不快，她随时可以敏捷的避开。
关雨这时候忽然加速，唐刀顿时劈斩在哈根的脖子上，反震的力量却让他差点没握住唐刀，一瞬间他就快速的退后。
其实刚刚哈根就注意到打扮诡异的关雨，只不过关雨距离他还有一段距离，所以他压根没在意，只是在专心想着怎么对付托妮，所以关雨的突袭还是让他有些意外，当他想要回头反击的时候，却发现关雨已经在他三米之外。

“该死，别以为速度快我就拿你们没办法！”哈根暴怒道，脖子上的青筋都凸起。
关雨忽然有一种不好的预感，立即大喝道：“快退后！”
托妮立即寻找掩护物，只见哈根手里忽然出现一把机枪，对着关雨就快速的扫射。
关雨跑的很快，哈根扫射的速度根本追不上他，一下子关雨就钻进了小巷。
哈根立即枪口一转，对着托妮所在的车辆进行扫射。
content_en:
016 Little BOSS Hagen!
In Guan Yu's perception, the image of the so-called detective is probably similar to the 'Sleeping Korokuro' in the longevity anime "Death Schoolboy" produced by Kojima.
A detective like Feng Wu is too fierce. His shooting skills are abnormal, his mind is abnormal, and his assets are abnormal. He is simply a pervert.
Guan Yu didn't believe that he was an ordinary detective at all.
Feng Wu drove the car five hundred meters away from the nightclub and stopped. None of the three people got out of the car and waited quietly.
Toni had finished her meaningless prayer. At this time, she pulled out two scimitars from her calf boots. The scimitars had a small arc and were very sharp. She wiped them carefully with a cloth.
These two scimitars are the source of her title of Mother Mantis!
The three of them were not the kind of impatient people. Feng Wu quickly assembled the sniper rifle, and at the same time took out the two silver pistols and started to install the silencer.
Although Guan Yu had a staff, he did not underestimate other tools. He loaded his pistol with bullets and wiped all the knives.
Then the three of them recharged their batteries and were ready to deal with various emergencies.
At around 11:30, cars finally started arriving one after another. These cars were unmarked police cars. Obviously the police didn't want to alert the snake and wanted to make a surprise attack on Hagen.
There were five police cars in total, two of which were vans. At this time, only one person was seen getting out of the car, slowly walking towards Feng Wu's car, and finally knocked on Feng Wu's car window.
"Old gangster, how are you prepared? Hagen is very likely to be carrying heavy weapons. You guys are not enough." Feng Wu opened the window and said calmly.
The person who came was the old gangster. He was obviously involved in the arrest, but Chen Tong was not present. After all, he was not the type to do this. He could deal with the common people, but he would probably be lying down in the blink of an eye when dealing with such criminals.
"Some people from the armed police will be here soon. If nothing goes wrong, even if old boy Hagen grows wings this time, he won't be able to fly." The old gangster held a cigarette in his mouth, lit it, squinted his eyes and took a puff, and then said confidently.
Feng Wu remained calm and said: "If you can't hold on any longer, leave quickly. I'll bring a good guy with me. Maybe he can help later."
"Let me see, holy shit, Barrett M107 sniper rifle, where did you get this thing? It couldn't have been that Miss Wen who helped you get it. To be honest, did you have an affair with that girl?" The old gangster suddenly exclaimed in a low voice, and then looked at Feng Wu in a lewd manner.
In the eyes of the old gangster, Feng Wu and Wen Yuan were indeed extremely matched. They were a match made in heaven. Unfortunately, Feng Wu always denied it.
"Miss Wen and I just have a cooperative relationship. It's probably impossible to have a relationship." Feng Wu denied it as expected, still looking extremely indifferent on his face.
The old gangster did not continue to tease Feng Wu, but looked inside the car. When he saw Toni, his eyes lit up. Then when he saw Guan Yu, he was stunned for a moment, then looked at Feng Wu and whispered: "Who is that guy?"
"His code name is Zero. He is the person sent by Miss Wen to assist us. His strength is not comparable to ours. You'd better not explore so much." Feng Wu also whispered, as if this was some kind of secret.
After hearing this, the old gangster muttered: "Those guys in power just have too many twists and turns in their minds. Forget it, I can't control it. I'll go back first."
This is the benefit of power. Feng Wu just built a little relationship, and even police gangsters like the old gangster didn't dare to mess around. If Feng Wu is not related to Wen Yuan, and Wen Yuan asks the police chief to step back, I am afraid that the old gangster will immediately ask Guan Yu to take off the skull mask on his face and then undergo an examination.
Also seeing so many weapons in Feng Wu's car, I'm afraid they will be arrested immediately.
Finally twelve o'clock arrived, and the armed police were ready. Immediately, a small group of people poured into the nightclub. It took about three minutesAfterwards, gunshots and a woman's screams were heard from the nightclub.
Feng Wu said calmly: "The battle has begun, and the people from Hagen's side are the first to shoot."
"How do you know?" Guan Yu said unexpectedly.
Toni smiled and said: "Feng Wu's facial features are very sensitive, and he can tell the model of the gun from the sound of the gun."
"The guns used by the police are uniform standard guns, and the gunfire just now was not the gunshot of the police gun." Feng Wu explained.
Suddenly there was an explosion in the nightclub, and dozens of armed police rushed into the nightclub. Apparently something had happened.
"What happened?" Guan Yu suddenly felt an ominous premonition in his heart. Hagen was afraid that he had acquired extraordinary skills, otherwise such a police force and a surprise attack would not have failed.
After a while, armed police began to run out of the nightclub. The three of them saw the old gangster suddenly fly out of the nightclub and hit the van. The surface of the van suddenly dented, and the old gangster fell crookedly to the ground.
"Something happened. I'm afraid Hagen is not that easy to deal with." Feng Wu said solemnly.
At this time, an armed policeman was shooting at the nightclub with a gun, but there was a look of fear on his face, as if he had seen a monster.
Suddenly, a black shadow flew out of the nightclub and hit the armed policeman. The armed policeman and the shadow immediately flew backwards.
Only when he stopped did he see clearly that the black shadow was also an armed policeman. How much strength does it take to throw an armed policeman out?
Finally, a burly man with golden light all over his body came out. This burly man was about forty years old. His hair was slicked back. He was wearing a white sleeveless vest on his upper body and a pair of flowery swimming trunks on his lower body. He looked extremely strong.
"He is Hagen, but the light on his body?" Feng Wu said softly.
Guan Yu shook his head and said: "I don't know, but it should be the effect of the skill."
At this time, the armed police ambushing around started shooting, and the bullets that landed on Hagen only produced a few sparks. There was no fear on his face, but he looked at the police around him with a sneer.
"What a monster." Toni couldn't help but sigh in a low voice when she saw this scene.
Hagen moved at this time. He casually crushed the marble pillar in front of the nightclub. Holding the pillar with one hand, he rushed forward and swept across the surrounding area. An armed policeman dragged the old gangster to escape the attack, but the surrounding cars were damaged and turned into scrap metal.
Suddenly there was a gunshot from upstairs, a sniper rifle!
However, the bullet only caused a small red dot when it hit Hagen. He looked up at the rooftop of the opposite building, suddenly roared, and threw the stone pillar directly towards the building.
"What's his strength?" Guan Yu looked at Hagen in shock. It would take twice his strength to hold such a stone pillar, but it would take at least twice as much to throw it at Hagen.
Hagen's strength and defense were far beyond his imagination.
In fact, he was not the only one who was shocked. Feng Wu and Toni were both shocked and speechless. Hagen's performance had subverted their imaginations. Such a scene should appear on the theater screen, not in reality.
The stone pillar did not attack the sniper, but it hit the third floor of the building, but only broke a wall.
Hagen's strength is not yet able to demolish buildings at will. This is already the limit of his power.
"Okay, let's go ahead. There is no time limit for Hagen's skill. Nearly thirty minutes have passed and we can kill him. Toni, please wait a moment and don't get caught by him. Hagen's power is enough to tear you in half." Feng Wu said at this time.
Toni nodded, immediately
And Guan Yu also got out of the car, holding Tang Dao in his hand and slowly walked towards Hagen. Facing such a powerful enemy, he was under great pressure, but he was the type who would never look back once he made a decision, and their chances of winning were still very high, so he decided to fight.Bundle!
Hagen's strength and defense were just higher than him, but in terms of speed, Hagen was too slow in his eyes. In the world of martial arts, only speed can't defeat him. As long as he's fast enough, it's useless no matter how strong he is, because he can't hit!
Feng Wu then walked towards the old gangster with a sniper rifle. In fact, there were many useless injuries among the armed policemen. They were just shocked by Hagen's performance and did not dare to take the lead now. The old gangster was said to have been an armed policeman before, so he should have some connections. This can be used.
Toni had already fought with Hagen at this time. She held a pistol in both hands and shot Hagen quickly. However, like everyone else, the bullets kept emitting sparks when they hit Hagen, but none of the bullets could penetrate Hagen's body.
When Hagen saw Toni, he suddenly smiled ferociously and said: "I didn't expect the female mantis to come looking for death. Don't let me catch you later, otherwise I will tear you in half, and you will even be in two halves!"
"Hmph, you bastard, if you die later, I will cut off your penis and make it into wine." Toni also cursed fiercely.
Although Toni wanted to kill Hagen immediately, she was not stupid, so she did not get close to Hagen at all, and Hagen was not very fast, so she could avoid him quickly at any time.
Guan Yu suddenly accelerated at this time, and the Tang Dao immediately struck Hagen's neck. The force of the shock made him almost lose his grip on the Tang Dao, and he quickly retreated in an instant.
In fact, just now Hagen noticed Guan Yu who was dressed strangely, but Guan Yu was still some distance away from him, so he didn't pay attention at all. He was just concentrating on how to deal with Toni, so Guan Yu's surprise attack still surprised him. When he wanted to turn around and fight back, he found that Guan Yu was already three meters away from him.
"Damn it, don't think I can't do anything to you because of your speed!" Hagen said angrily, the veins on his neck bulging.
Guan Yu suddenly had a bad premonition and immediately shouted: "Back off!"
Toni immediately looked for cover, only to see a machine gun suddenly appear in Hagen's hand, and he fired rapidly at Guan Yu.
Guan Yu ran very fast, and Hagen's shooting speed could not catch up with him. Guan Yu suddenly got into the alley.
Hagen immediately turned his gun and fired at Toni's vehicle.
